race.title: Jumps Looks Better On Racing TV Mares' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: CHOSEN HERO made a successful start over hurdles for the James Owen yard last time and is likely to prove a different proposition now as to when she was last sighted over fences. She gets the nod if turning out quickly. Gata Ban is a reliable sort for this level and should prove a stern opponent, whilst Sweet Nightingale isn't ruled out on the back of an encouraging comeback run. CHOSEN HERO (IRE) GATA BAN (IRE) SWEET NIGHTINGALE
race.bettingForecast: Gata Ban (11/8), Chosen Hero (15/8), Eastern Shores (8/1), Miss Kassiopi (10/1), Sweet Nightingale (10/1), I Am The Moon (12/1)
